summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by International General Insurance Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting its press release of first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing contains routine earnings data—gross written premiums, net income, combined ratio, and EPS—along with commentary on capital returns (share repurchases and dividends including an extraordinary dividend). There is no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or strategic review. The content is purely an ordinary periodic earnings report with no event-driven corporate action.
